collection.title: Subaru Forester 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Subaru Forester 2013 - 2019 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Forester, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
